snippet.title: Barn Rush - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab food, haul a wobbly stack back to the barn, and beat the clock. Barn Rush is a time-attack roguelite about farm animals in fifteen-second rounds.

Free demo: Friday, October 16, for Steam Next Fest (Windows, Mac and Linux).
Full game: November 16.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5158740/Barn_Rush/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
Press kit: https://barnrush.com/press

Music: "Three Red Hearts - Box Jump" by Abstraction (https://abstractionmusic.com/)
